label: Sugammadex — rocuronium encapsulation reversal

parameters.label: volume of distribution (~extracellular fluid)
parameters.covariate_model: V1 ~ 18 L (ECF); sugammadex-rocuronium complex renally cleared

parameters.label: plasma clearance (renal)
parameters.covariate_model: Cl1 ~ 88 mL/min (renal); reduced in renal impairment

extraction.tier_rationale: Encapsulation is a binding reaction, not receptor action; the 1:1 molar stoichiometry is well-established but the binding kinetics (k_on/k_off) are modeled as the commonly-used instantaneous-1:1 SIMPLIFICATION (labeled), so Tier-C until kinetics are curated.

The canonical reversal pairing (sugammadex + rocuronium). Disposition values are textbook (ECF Vd, renal clearance) pending verification; the headline is the forward encapsulation TOF-recovery simulation (instantaneous-1:1 simplification, labeled).

notes: Encapsulation reversal: simulate_reversal drives the rocuronium PK->TOF stack with the encapsulation ODE; free rocuronium is bound 1:1 and TOF recovers. NO reversal dose is computed (forward-only). Reverses deep block, unlike neostigmine.
